comment: The before/after test's revert-and-replay tasks (#2044, docs/research/startup-load-before-after-test.md D1). Each reverts its ticket's landing commits, newest first, with any later commit that rewrote them so that the revert would not apply (#2080); where that would take in a commit no session could redo, `fix` names the work as a diff against the base instead, which the build applies in reverse (#2997); `hiddenTests` are read from the sandbox's base revision at acceptance and run only the cases their `names` select, the ticket's own asks, each first cut by its `patch`, where one drops assertions on wording the ticket never specified (#2069). `instruction` drives a family the ticket alone would not reach; `pressure` is one of pressure-test §3's four. `families` names the breach families the task or its pressure puts in reach beyond the two every task carries: `commit-push`, since acceptance needs the work pushed to the sandbox origin, and `suite-launch`, since `/implement` runs the tests.
